questions.question: How much does a wedding DJ cost in NYC?
questions.answer: Wedding DJs in NYC start at a median of $2,370 for a wedding.

questions.question: How much does a wedding photographer cost in the New York area?
questions.answer: Wedding photographers in the New York area start at a median of $3,500.

questions.question: How much does an event photographer cost per hour in the New York area?
questions.answer: Photographers who publish a price per hour start at a median of $400 per hour.
